title: Druidic Ritual
start: Talk to Kaqemeex at the stone circle north of Taverley south of the Heroes' Guild.

items.t: Vial (given by Sanfew if none are in your backpack)

rewards.t: 15 noted grimy guams and eye of newt

steps.t: Talk to Kaqemeex south of the Heroes' Guild. [Chat: 1 Talk about Druidic Ritual. › 1 What do you need help with? › 1 I'm pretty sure I've heard that before. › Accept]
Run directly south and enter the last house on the west near the Herblore icon.
Talk to Sanfew. [Chat: 1 I've been sent to help make an ointment of imbalance for Kaqemeex. › 4 Ok, I'll do that then.]
Go north and enter the Burthorpe Slayer Cave directly east of the crayfish pond.
Head south and fill your vial at the subterranean spring for a vial of living water.
Head south until you find wandering wyrmwood, then take-from one of them for wandering wyrmwood.
At the west part of the lake, bait the Sparkling Fishing Spot.
Gather-scales from the stone fish, choosing the chisel option.
Talk to Sanfew for a cutscene.
